summary: Practise NGO conflict analysis, negotiation, and mediation with case-based exercises. Explore the five-day course and assess its fit for your team.
lede: Conflict resolution training for non-profits helps NGO programme, HR and partnership professionals assess disputes and choose proportionate responses. Participants map conflict causes, stakeholders and power dynamics, prepare interest-based negotiations, and practise facilitated dialogue for workplace, partner, programme and community disagreements. They also learn to document actions and follow-up, and to recognize when safeguarding concerns call for referral rather than informal mediation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for NGO professionals who handle team, partner, programme, or community conflict as part of their work. It is most useful if you have some experience in NGO operations and want a consistent, practical approach to analysis and resolution.
modules: NGO Conflict Dynamics and Do No Harm
prerequisites: Recommended: working familiarity with NGO programme, people, or partnership operations and experience handling routine workplace disagreements. No formal mediation qualification or coding experience is required. You should be prepared to work with anonymized or fictionalized case scenarios rather than disclose sensitive live cases.
